description: This file defines the class 'StandardDeviation' which computes the sample or population standard deviation, wrapping the 'Variance' class and providing methods to evaluate standard deviation from data arrays or incrementally. It is part of the 'org.apache.commons.math3.stat.descriptive.moment' package.

classes.name: StandardDeviation
classes.description: A class for computing the standard deviation, either sample or population, based on the variance, supporting incremental updates and array evaluations.
